description: Get one invoice (Rechnung) by its sevDesk id with its positions (Positionen: name, quantity, unit, unit price net/gross, tax rate, discount, sums), totals (net, Umsatzsteuer, gross; EUR and document currency for foreign-currency invoices), tax rule (Steuerregel), recipient address, payment terms (Zahlungsziel, Skonto), delivery date (Leistungsdatum), paid amount, the order it was created from (origin; open it with sevdesk_order_get), the invoice a cancellation (SR) cancels and dunning data (Mahnung). Use it after sevdesk_invoices_list. Contact details: sevdesk_contact_get.

id.description: Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.

name: sevdesk_invoice_get
title: Get a sevDesk invoice
